device.description: 14-bit 100 MSPS current-output DAC (CommsDAC) with parallel CMOS input, clocked input latch
device.note: ths5671a.pdf (SLAS201A) p.1 pinout, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 supplies (DVDD 3-5.5 V), p.6 digital specifications, p.15-16 data interface and timing, input modes

registers.name: DATA
registers.note: input word latched by the edge-triggered input flip-flops; power-on value not given (0 used)

commands.name: DATA WORD
commands.note: D13-D0 latched on the rising edge of CLK (p.15-16): the parallel write ends at CLK rising

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (supplies), p.6 (digital timing), p.15-16 (data interface, timing diagram, input modes)
notModeled: analog: complementary current outputs IOUT1/IOUT2, internal 1.2 V reference (EXTIO/EXTLO), full-scale bias (BIASJ), COMP1/COMP2 decoupling
MODE pin: straight binary (MODE = 0) or twos complement (MODE = 1) input coding changes only the analog mapping; the stored word is the latched input bits
SLEEP asynchronous power-down (active high, internal pull-down): analog only, not modeled
one clock cycle conversion latency (td(D)); the stored word is the last word latched
power-on contents of the input latch not given (0 used)
internal pull-down on MODE and SLEEP
variants: pin-compatible CommsDAC family with separate datasheets: THS5641 (8-bit), THS5651 (10-bit), THS5661 (12-bit); higher resolutions use the NC pins 9-14 for the lower data bits
